about_the_game:
Welcome to Zombietown!


Each zombie has a unique ability. Some zombies are fast, some are slow, and others even explode! Your job is to escape town while taking out the zombies. Watch out for the zombies that shoot lasers, and stay on your feet for the zombies that throw eggs. You never know who could be around the next corner!

But Don't Worry, You Have The Right Tools For The Job


You can find different equipment around the map. Guns eliminate zombies quickly, but you can run out of ammo if you're not careful. Pills give you temporary powerups, so make them count. Health packs heal you when you get hit by the zombies, and grenades blow up zombies in different ways. The impact blows them up instantly, the incendiary lights the zombies on fire, and the decoy distracts them - the perfect getaway!

short_description: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.
